oral_examination.oral_examination: 36 Black caries can be seen in the pits and fissures of the occlusal surface, with a large amount of soft rot and food residue inside. The probe can be inserted into the pits and fissures. The surface is rough and there is a slight sour feeling when probing. The teeth are slightly sensitive to cold water stimulation. The cold diagnosis is the same as the control teeth. There is no pain when percussion. There is a small amount of soft calculus on the gingival margin.

treatment_plan.notes: Strictly abide by the "Precautions after Tooth Extraction", take oral antibiotics (bring your own), and follow up with doctors if you feel uncomfortable. Sutures will be removed after one week

source_handle: 36 After caries removal, the middle layer of dentin is reached, the cavity is trimmed, 3m of the eighth generation adhesive is applied, mesoplastic resin is filled, blended and polished
